source_policy.basis: 本项目对日版 ROM 关卡脚本（跳关、部队变动、胜败条件、出击配套记录）与常驻代码的静态解析；话数按跳关脚本逐路线推算

sources: Source: this project's analysis of the Japanese ROM's stage scripts and code (docs/gameplay/, docs/script/)
Compared against: the Akurasu Wiki pages for Super Robot Wars 64 (retrieved 2026-10-01); differences, or things it doesn't list, are marked with badges
Names come from this project's Chinese term table; choice text comes from this project's Chinese script

boxes.title: Protagonist and Real/Super
items: Choose one of four protagonists at the start: Ark and Selain are Real, Brad and Manami are Super; the two sides merge from stage 7 “Blade of Anguish”, though some stages and recruits still differ by side
Each protagonist has a dedicated rival; recruiting them takes conditions built up from the early game; see the hidden element “Protagonist-specific”
Real goes straight from “Destiny Astray” to “Shock at Victoria”, while Super plays one extra stage, “Town of Betrayal”; from then on Real is 1 stage behind Super in numbering

boxes.title: Three major branches
items: The choice at the end of “Operation Daybreak” (Super stage 20, Real stage 19) decides between the OZ route and the Independence Army route; once you join OZ there's no going back

On the Independence Army route, meeting the conditions in “The Battle of Ryozanpaku” switches you to the Complete Pacifism route; the Complete Pacifism route chooses again in “Return to the Battlefield”: following Treize merges into the second half of OZ from “Prelude to Ruin”, fighting alone merges into the second half of the Independence Army route from “Galactic Empire Vanguard Fleet”

At the end of “Nightmare, Once More” / “A Nightmare with No Waking”, choose to go to Muge space or stay in the Earth Sphere; while the team is split, the other group's members temporarily can't deploy (they stay in the team), and from “Terror! Dark Axis Activates! (Part 1)” both sides reunite for the final chapter

boxes.title: Tips
items: Conditions for recruiting, defending a base or breaking through within a time limit often span several stages and cannot be fixed after failing; save to a separate slot before key stages

Card stage numbers are worked out route by route from the ROM's stage-jump script, taking the most common across all paths; Real, Complete Pacifism → fighting alone, the Ark / Brad exclusive side branches, and the Cyber Beast Force Base and Desperate Breakthrough branches all shift the numbers; the first note on each card gives the actual stage number in each case {≠}
Kill-count conditions (Ginrei, Silky, Kurtz, etc.) each have a fixed check point (stage start, stage end or a specific event); the cards give the timing, so build up kills in advance
Turn numbers always refer to the turn shown on screen
This port's “Gameplay adjustments” corrections are on by default; skill and battle values follow the “this port's default” noted on the data pages
